key: "PxLS* 01"
en: "PxLS* 01"
ja: 「PxLS* 01」

key: zeL: Please calm down! Please!
en: zeL: Please calm down! Please!
ja: ゼル: 落ち着いて! お願いだから!

key: Zel: Just what the hell did you mess up so badly?
en: Zel: Just what the hell did you mess up so badly?
ja: ゼル: いったい　何を　そんなに　しくじったんだよ?

key: zEl: This wasn't a user error.
en: zEl: This wasn't a user error.
ja: ゼル: これは　操作ミスじゃない。

key: Some kind of corrupted program must have been injected into the system.
en: Some kind of corrupted program must have been injected into the system.
ja: 何らかの　破損したプログラムが　システムに　注入されたに　違いない。

key: Zel: So then your security was just shit.
en: Zel: So then your security was just shit.
ja: ゼル: つまり　お前のセキュリティが　クソだったってことか。

key: zeL: Stop blaming her! I don't see you helping!
en: zeL: Stop blaming her! I don't see you helping!
ja: ゼル: 彼女を　責めるのは　やめて! あんたは　何も　手伝ってないでしょ!

key: Zel: Shut up, Lumi. Can the data be repaired or not?
en: Zel: Shut up, Lumi. Can the data be repaired or not?
ja: ゼル: 黙れ　ルミ。データは　修復できるのか　できないのか。

key: zEl: All PULSE2 and Arc-PULSE data has been left unaltered.
en: zEl: All PULSE2 and Arc-PULSE data has been left unaltered.
ja: ゼル: PULSE2と　アークPULSEのデータは　すべて　無事に　残っている。

key: However, the PULSE-Magnezone damage is irreparable.
en: However, the PULSE-Magnezone damage is irreparable.
ja: しかし　PULSE-ジバコイルの損傷は　修復不可能。

key: I will need to rewrite it.
en: I will need to rewrite it.
ja: 書き直す　必要が　ある。

key: zeL: What? But... if Magnezone is damaged--
en: zeL: What? But... if Magnezone is damaged--
ja: ゼル: えっ? でも……　ジバコイルが　損傷してるなら――

key: Zel: There's no time to rewrite it! Lin wanted all the PULSEs out of here hours ago.
en: Zel: There's no time to rewrite it! Lin wanted all the PULSEs out of here hours ago.
ja: ゼル: 書き直してる時間なんて　ねぇ! リンは　もう何時間も前に　PULSEを　全部　ここから　出せって　言ってたんだぞ。

key: zEl: I'm aware. Hence why the other projects have been safely relocated.
en: zEl: I'm aware. Hence why the other projects have been safely relocated.
ja: ゼル: わかってる。だからこそ　他の計画は　安全に　移動済み。

key: However, Magnezone cannot be moved under the current circumstances.
en: However, Magnezone cannot be moved under the current circumstances.
ja: しかし　ジバコイルは　現状では　移動できない。

key: The timing could not be worse.
en: The timing could not be worse.
ja: これ以上ないほど　最悪の　タイミング。

key: Zel: Tch, Lin must have known this was coming.
en: Zel: Tch, Lin must have known this was coming.
ja: ゼル: チッ　リンは　こうなるって　わかってたに　違いねぇ。

key: I bet it has something to do with the hero brigade she had hauled in here.
en: I bet it has something to do with the hero brigade she had hauled in here.
ja: あいつが　ここに　連れ込んだ　ヒーローどもと　何か　関係　あるんだろうぜ。

key: They're probably plotting to destroy Magnezone like all the other ones.
en: They're probably plotting to destroy Magnezone like all the other ones.
ja: どうせ　他のやつらと　同じように　ジバコイルを　破壊しようって　企んでるんだろう。

key: Zel: Speak of the devil, huh?
en: Zel: Speak of the devil, huh?
ja: ゼル: うわさをすれば　ってやつか。

key: zEl: So it's too late already.
en: zEl: So it's too late already.
ja: ゼル: つまり　もう　手遅れ。

key: zeL: \PN... Did you really come to destroy everything here?
en: zeL: \PN... Did you really come to destroy everything here?
ja: ゼル: \PN……　本当に　ここにあるもの　全部　壊しに　来たの?

key: Zel: I knew it.
en: Zel: I knew it.
ja: ゼル: やっぱりな。

key: Well, there's no way in hell we're gonna let you do that!
en: Well, there's no way in hell we're gonna let you do that!
ja: そんなこと　絶対に　やらせねぇからな!

key: Zel: Yeah, right. Don't bother lying!
en: Zel: Yeah, right. Don't bother lying!
ja: ゼル: ああ　そうかよ。ウソつくのは　やめとけ!

key: We know all about your little hacking scheme too!
en: We know all about your little hacking scheme too!
ja: お前の　ちっぽけなハッキング計画のことも　全部　知ってんだよ!

key: There's no way in hell we're gonna let you get away with this!
en: There's no way in hell we're gonna let you get away with this!
ja: こんなこと　絶対に　やらせて　たまるかよ!

key: zEl: Control your temper, Zero.
en: zEl: Control your temper, Zero.
ja: ゼル: 落ち着いて　ゼロ。

key: Remember, Lin requested that \PN not be harmed.
en: Remember, Lin requested that \PN not be harmed.
ja: 忘れないで　リンは　\PNを　傷つけるなと　言っていた。

key: Zel: Yeah, but I'm not about to sit back and let them do whatever they want with my projects.
en: Zel: Yeah, but I'm not about to sit back and let them do whatever they want with my projects.
ja: ゼル: ああ　だがな　オレの計画を　好き勝手に　させて　黙って　見てるつもりは　ねぇんだよ。

key: zeL: Your projects? Eve is the one that does all the hard work!
en: zeL: Your projects? Eve is the one that does all the hard work!
ja: ゼル: あんたの計画? 大変な作業を　全部　やってるのは　イヴなんだからね!

key: You just bully her all the time!
en: You just bully her all the time!
ja: あんたは　いつも　彼女を　いじめてるだけじゃない!

key: Zel: Just stop talking and fight already!
en: Zel: Just stop talking and fight already!
ja: ゼル: ごちゃごちゃ言ってねぇで　さっさと　戦えよ!

key: zEl: Lumi, regardless of what happens now-- please remember that I will always, always love you.
en: zEl: Lumi, regardless of what happens now-- please remember that I will always, always love you.
ja: ゼル: ルミ、これから何が起きても――ぼくが　ずっと　ずっと　キミを愛してることだけは　忘れないで

key: zeL: Magnezone, Magnezone, no! Please be okay!
en: zeL: Magnezone, Magnezone, no! Please be okay!
ja: ゼル: ジバコイル　ジバコイル　だめ! お願い　無事でいて!

key: Please--
en: Please--
ja: お願い――

key: Zel: ...
en: Zel: ...
ja: ゼル: ……

key: Uggh...
en: Uggh...
ja: うぐ……

key: It's so quiet...
en: It's so quiet...
ja: やけに　静かだ……

key: The PULSE--
en: The PULSE--
ja: PULSEが――

key: Zel: We didn't lose hearing in the explosion, did we?
en: Zel: We didn't lose hearing in the explosion, did we?
ja: ゼル: 爆発で　耳が　やられたわけじゃ　ねぇよな?

key: Zel: The PULSE--
en: Zel: The PULSE--
ja: ゼル: PULSEが――

key: We didn't lose hearing in the explosion, did we?
en: We didn't lose hearing in the explosion, did we?
ja: 爆発で　耳が　やられたわけじゃ　ねぇよな?

key: H-hey, Lumi, Eve! Say something!
en: H-hey, Lumi, Eve! Say something!
ja: お　おい　ルミ　イヴ! 何か　言ってくれ!

key: No-- Magnezone!
en: No-- Magnezone!
ja: だめだ――　ジバコイル!
コリン・ルージュ: 私は……

key: I'm alone.
en: I'm alone.
ja: ひとりぼっちだ。

key: I'm alone...
en: I'm alone...
ja: ひとりぼっちだ……

key: I'm alone, I'm alone, I'm alone, I'm alone, I'm alone...
en: I'm alone, I'm alone, I'm alone, I'm alone, I'm alone...
ja: ひとりぼっちだ　ひとりぼっちだ　ひとりぼっちだ　ひとりぼっちだ　ひとりぼっちだ……

key: And I'm...
en: And I'm...
ja: そして　私は……

key: Empty.
en: Empty.
ja: 空っぽだ。

key: Zel: I need to get to Agate.
en: Zel: I need to get to Agate.
ja: ゼル: アゲートに　行かなきゃ。

key: FLORA: Oh my god...
en: FLORA: Oh my god...
ja: フローラ: うそでしょ……

key: It's a PULSE machine...
en: It's a PULSE machine...
ja: PULSEマシンだ……

key: So you weren't just pulling my leg. Interesting.
en: So you weren't just pulling my leg. Interesting.
ja: からかってたわけじゃ　なかったのね。面白いじゃない。

key: This one looks even worse than the other.
en: This one looks even worse than the other.
ja: こっちは　前のより　ひどい状態ね。

key: Even so...
en: Even so...
ja: それでも……

key: Time to get to work.
en: Time to get to work.
ja: さあ　仕事に　取りかかりましょ。

key: FLORA: No, no, this just won't do.
en: FLORA: No, no, this just won't do.
ja: フローラ: だめだめ　これじゃ　全然　だめ。

key: FLORA: First of all, the lighting in this room is trash.
en: FLORA: First of all, the lighting in this room is trash.
ja: フローラ: まず　この部屋の　照明が　ゴミすぎる。

key: Second of all, this room and machine are both trashed.
en: Second of all, this room and machine are both trashed.
ja: それに　この部屋も　マシンも　どっちも　ボロボロだし。

key: Keeping things consistent here, I see.
en: Keeping things consistent here, I see.
ja: 一貫性は　あるってわけね。

key: Just kidding, I can't see shit.
en: Just kidding, I can't see shit.
ja: 冗談よ　マジで何も　見えないんだけど。

key: \PN!
en: \PN!
ja: \PNってば!

key: I'm... I'm very grateful, \PN, but... Um...
en: I'm... I'm very grateful, \PN, but... Um...
ja: その……　すごく　感謝してるのよ\PN　でも……　えっと……

key: This was kind of, um, a waste of time because the machine is so heavily damaged!
en: This was kind of, um, a waste of time because the machine is so heavily damaged!
ja: マシンが　あまりにも　ひどく壊れてるせいで　ちょっと　時間のむだに　なっちゃって!

key: I'm so sorry to ask you this, but do you happen to know of a PULSE machine that's in better sorts?
en: I'm so sorry to ask you this, but do you happen to know of a PULSE machine that's in better sorts?
ja: こんなこと　頼んで　悪いんだけど　もっと　状態のいいPULSEマシン　どこか　知らない?

key: FLORA: Thank hell...
en: FLORA: Thank hell...
ja: フローラ: あー　地獄に　感謝……

key: I-I mean, thank goodness!
en: I-I mean, thank goodness!
ja: じ　じゃなくて　よかったぁ!

key: 'Kay, so... Where would this other PULSE machine be?
en: 'Kay, so... Where would this other PULSE machine be?
ja: それで……　その別のPULSEマシンって　どこに　あるの?

key: FLORA: ...
en: FLORA: ...
ja: フローラ: ……

key: I'm so sorry, I must've misheard you?
en: I'm so sorry, I must've misheard you?
ja: ごめん　聞き間違えたかしら?

key: I thought you said something about a Clawitzer PULSE up in Labradorra City, just now?
en: I thought you said something about a Clawitzer PULSE up in Labradorra City, just now?
ja: 今　ラブラドラシティの　ブロスターPULSEがどうとか　言った気がしたんだけど?

key: But um...
en: But um...
ja: でも　えっと……

key: If I'm not mistaken, \PN, and I think I'm not!
en: If I'm not mistaken, \PN, and I think I'm not!
ja: あたしの記憶違いじゃなければ\PN　いや　絶対　違ってないと思うけど!

key: Were we not JUST up in Labradorra looking at that?
en: Were we not JUST up in Labradorra looking at that?
ja: あたしたち　ついさっき　ラブラドラで　それ　見たばっかり　じゃなかった?

key: Surely there's something else!
en: Surely there's something else!
ja: 絶対　他にも　何か　あるはずよ!

key: There really must be, oh, prettiest of pleases!
en: There really must be, oh, prettiest of pleases!
ja: ぜったい　あるって　言って　お願いだから!

key: FLORA: It's ALSO in LABRADORRA?!
en: FLORA: It's ALSO in LABRADORRA?!
ja: フローラ: それも　ラブラドラに　あるの?!

key: FLORA: LABRADORRA??
en: FLORA: LABRADORRA??
ja: フローラ: ラブラドラ??

key: DO YOU KNOW WHERE WE JUST WERE?
en: DO YOU KNOW WHERE WE JUST WERE?
ja: あたしたちが　さっきまで　どこに　いたか　わかってる?

key: WE WERE LITERALLY JUST IN LABRADORRA!
en: WE WERE LITERALLY JUST IN LABRADORRA!
ja: ついさっきまで　文字通り　ラブラドラに　いたのよ!

key: LITERALLY.
en: LITERALLY.
ja: 文字通り。

key: RIGHT.
en: RIGHT.
ja: まさに。

key: THERE.
en: THERE.
ja: あそこに。

key: WE WERE PRACTICALLY RIGHT NEXT TO LABRADORRA!
en: WE WERE PRACTICALLY RIGHT NEXT TO LABRADORRA!
ja: ほとんど　ラブラドラの　すぐそばに　いたようなもんじゃない!

key: WHY DID YOU MAKE US TRAVEL ALL THE WAY--
en: WHY DID YOU MAKE US TRAVEL ALL THE WAY--
ja: なんで　わざわざ　あんな遠くまで　あたしたちを　行かせて――

key: FLORA: Calm down, Flora.
en: FLORA: Calm down, Flora.
ja: フローラ: 落ち着いて　フローラ。

key: Oceans.
en: Oceans.
ja: 海。

key: Waves.
en: Waves.
ja: 波。

key: You are at the beach.
en: You are at the beach.
ja: あなたは　ビーチに　いる。

key: The wind is blowing...
en: The wind is blowing...
ja: 風が　吹いている……

key: A Wingull just flew off with your steak tartar...
en: A Wingull just flew off with your steak tartar...
ja: キャモメが　あなたの　タルタルステーキを　くわえて　飛んでいった……

key: FLORA: Um, so sorry about that outburst!
en: FLORA: Um, so sorry about that outburst!
ja: フローラ: あの　さっきの　取り乱し方　ごめんなさい!

key: I just... Don't understand...
en: I just... Don't understand...
ja: ただ……　理解できなくて……

key: You know what? Nevermind.
en: You know what? Nevermind.
ja: ま　いいわ。もう気にしないで。

key: So, below Labradorra it is, then?
en: So, below Labradorra it is, then?
ja: それじゃ　ラブラドラの下ってことね?

key: So, Labradorra City it is, then?
en: So, Labradorra City it is, then?
ja: それじゃ　ラブラドラシティってことね?

key: Okay! Take me there then!
en: Okay! Take me there then!
ja: よし! じゃあ　連れて行って!

key: We're going together! Okay! Haha.
en: We're going together! Okay! Haha.
ja: 一緒に　行くのよ! よし! あはは。

key: ACE: You come across what looks to be a lake of simmering sand.
en: ACE: You come across what looks to be a lake of simmering sand.
ja: エース: 目の前に　ぐつぐつと煮えたぎる砂の湖のようなものが　現れます。

key: Specks of shifting granules swell up in a mound and then--
en: Specks of shifting granules swell up in a mound and then--
ja: 揺れ動く粒の集まりが　盛り上がって　やがて――

key: Pop!!!
en: Pop!!!
ja: ポン!!!

key: From bright white at the surface, to a tawny glow at their deepest points, each burst of the boiling bubbles brings the mixture to a bit darker of a color.
en: From bright white at the surface, to a tawny glow at their deepest points, each burst of the boiling bubbles brings the mixture to a bit darker of a color.
ja: 表面の明るい白から　最も深いところの　黄褐色の輝きまで　煮え立つ泡が　はじけるたびに　その混合物は　少しずつ　色を　濃くしていきます。

key: Would any volunteers like to make a perception check?
en: Would any volunteers like to make a perception check?
ja: 誰か　知覚判定を　してみたい人は?

key: LUMI: Ooh, I've got it!
en: LUMI: Ooh, I've got it!
ja: ルミ: あ　わたし　やる!

key: LUMI: Okay, I got a 17!
en: LUMI: Okay, I got a 17!
ja: ルミ: よし　17!

key: ACE: So, your eyes aren't quite sure what you're looking at,
en: ACE: So, your eyes aren't quite sure what you're looking at,
ja: エース: あなたの目には　それが何なのか　はっきりとは　わかりません

key: But it takes just a quick moment for your nose to be in the knows.
en: But it takes just a quick moment for your nose to be in the knows.
ja: ですが　鼻が　それを　悟るのに　時間は　かかりませんでした。

key: One whiff of the air and you immediately recognize the syrupy-sweet smell around you as a mixture of sugar and heat.
en: One whiff of the air and you immediately recognize the syrupy-sweet smell around you as a mixture of sugar and heat.
ja: 空気を　ひと嗅ぎしただけで　あたりに漂う　シロップのように甘い香りが　砂糖と熱の混ざったものだと　すぐに　わかります。

key: You have found a caramel hot spring!
en: You have found a caramel hot spring!
ja: あなたは　キャラメル温泉を　見つけました!

key: LUMI: Cool!
en: LUMI: Cool!
ja: ルミ: かっこいい!

key: By the way, I'm glad \PN could hang out with us today to see this too!
en: By the way, I'm glad \PN could hang out with us today to see this too!
ja: ところで　今日は\PNも　一緒に　これを見られて　うれしいな!

key: EVE: Speaking of, where is Taka?
en: EVE: Speaking of, where is Taka?
ja: イヴ: そういえば　タカは　どこ?

key: ACE: I'm afraid the little prince didn't pick up the phone this morning...
en: ACE: I'm afraid the little prince didn't pick up the phone this morning...
ja: エース: 残念ながら　小さな王子さまは　今朝　電話に　出なかったようで……

key: I'm sure he's just had a long night and needs his rest, but rest you all assured, he'll be back with us before long!
en: I'm sure he's just had a long night and needs his rest, but rest you all assured, he'll be back with us before long!
ja: きっと　長い夜を過ごして　休息が必要なだけでしょう　ですが　ご安心を　まもなく　私たちのもとに　戻ってくるはずです!

key: ACE: It seems he was called away to the Grand Hall on some sudden and urgent business.
en: ACE: It seems he was called away to the Grand Hall on some sudden and urgent business.
ja: エース: どうやら　急ぎの用件で　大ホールに　呼ばれたようですね。

key: No matter, we can fill him in on your adventures next week!
en: No matter, we can fill him in on your adventures next week!
ja: かまいません　来週　あなたたちの冒険について　彼に　伝えましょう!

key: ACE: Anyway, also on a 17, you notice a large, shadowy figure moving somewhere very near what you can only assume is the bottom of the spring.
en: ACE: Anyway, also on a 17, you notice a large, shadowy figure moving somewhere very near what you can only assume is the bottom of the spring.
ja: エース: ともあれ　その17の判定でも　温泉の底あたりと思われる場所を　大きな影のような何かが　動いているのに　気づきます。

key: ZERO: I stab the shadowy figure.
en: ZERO: I stab the shadowy figure.
ja: ゼロ: その影を　刺す。

key: ACE: At a glance, the figure appears to be much deeper within the caramel than your foil would reach.
en: ACE: At a glance, the figure appears to be much deeper within the caramel than your foil would reach.
ja: エース: 一目見た限り　その影は　あなたの剣が　届くよりも　ずっと　キャラメルの奥深くに　いるようです。

key: ZERO: I stab the caramel.
en: ZERO: I stab the caramel.
ja: ゼロ: キャラメルを　刺す。

key: ACE: Well, of course you do.
en: ACE: Well, of course you do.
ja: エース: ええ　もちろん　そうしますよね。

key: ACE: All right, so you swiftly draw your Moonlight Stinger with a 'swish!' and plunge it straight into the caramel concoction with a forceful thrust.
en: ACE: All right, so you swiftly draw your Moonlight Stinger with a 'swish!' and plunge it straight into the caramel concoction with a forceful thrust.
ja: エース: では　あなたは「シャッ」と　素早く　ムーンライトスティンガーを抜き　力強い一撃で　キャラメルの混合物へと　まっすぐ　突き刺します。

key: ACE: But suddenly, it sticks fast in the gluey goo!
en: ACE: But suddenly, it sticks fast in the gluey goo!
ja: エース: しかし　突然　ねばついた塊に　しっかりと　絡めとられてしまいます!

key: Zoro, please give me a strength save.
en: Zoro, please give me a strength save.
ja: ゾロ　筋力セーヴィングを　振ってください。

key: ZERO: ...Uh, 11.
en: ZERO: ...Uh, 11.
ja: ゼロ: ……えっと　11。

key: ACE: On an 11, you try as best you can to shove your sword through the gelatinous gallimaufry, but you just can't get it deeper than a foot or so.
en: ACE: On an 11, you try as best you can to shove your sword through the gelatinous gallimaufry, but you just can't get it deeper than a foot or so.
ja: エース: 11ということで　あなたは　力の限り　このゼリー状の混合物に　剣を　押しこもうとしますが　30センチほどより　深くは　どうしても　入っていきません。

key: Zoro quickly learns that caramel can be very hard and sticky when it wants to be.
en: Zoro quickly learns that caramel can be very hard and sticky when it wants to be.
ja: ゾロは　キャラメルというものが　その気になれば　とても硬く　ねばつくものだと　すぐに　思い知らされます。

key: But, you do manage to free your sword from the goop, albeit newly-crested with a quickly- crystallizing crown of caramel.
en: But, you do manage to free your sword from the goop, albeit newly-crested with a quickly- crystallizing crown of caramel.
ja: ですが　なんとか　剣を　その塊から　引き抜くことは　できました　もっとも　急速に結晶化する　キャラメルの冠を　新たに　まとうことに　なりましたが。

key: ZERO: ...I lick the caramel.
en: ZERO: ...I lick the caramel.
ja: ゼロ: ……キャラメルを　なめる。

key: ACE: Ah, so Zoro takes a moment to lick the caramel from his blade.
en: ACE: Ah, so Zoro takes a moment to lick the caramel from his blade.
ja: エース: ああ　ではゾロは　しばし　刃についたキャラメルを　なめとります。

key: Let us assume it rapidly cools fast enough so as he would not burn himself.
en: Let us assume it rapidly cools fast enough so as he would not burn himself.
ja: やけどしない程度に　すぐに　冷めたと　しておきましょう。

key: Any living mortal would fastly find that it is among the most delicious concoctions ever created,
en: Any living mortal would fastly find that it is among the most delicious concoctions ever created,
ja: 生きている人間なら　誰もが　すぐに　これが　今までで最高に　おいしい混合物のひとつだと　気づくでしょうが

key: But for Zoro von Zilchenstein, undead lord that he is, it brings no such comfort.
en: But for Zoro von Zilchenstein, undead lord that he is, it brings no such comfort.
ja: しかし　アンデッドの君主である　ゾロ・フォン・ジルヒェンシュタインには　そんな慰めは　もたらされません。

key: It is too flavorless to enjoy, and yet the still-lingering heat and several unsteady droplets remind him of the blood he is bound by his vampire nature to drink.
en: It is too flavorless to enjoy, and yet the still-lingering heat and several unsteady droplets remind him of the blood he is bound by his vampire nature to drink.
ja: 味気なさすぎて　楽しめないものの　まだ残るその熱と　不安定に垂れる数滴が　ヴァンパイアの性として　飲むことを　運命づけられた血を　彼に　思い出させます。

key: EVE: Yveraanya will quickly enchant the caramel to taste more appealing to him.
en: EVE: Yveraanya will quickly enchant the caramel to taste more appealing to him.
ja: イヴ: イヴェラーニャは　すぐさま　キャラメルに　彼の口に合うような味になる魔法を　かけます。

key: ACE: Right, Zoro; nevermind anything I just said!
en: ACE: Right, Zoro; nevermind anything I just said!
ja: エース: では　ゾロ　今　言ったことは　全部　忘れてください!

key: Actually, this is the most delicious caramel you've ever tasted in your un-life.
en: Actually, this is the most delicious caramel you've ever tasted in your un-life.
ja: 実際　これは　あなたの死してなお続く生涯の中で　最もおいしいキャラメルです。

key: LUMI: Ooh, I wanna make a caramel popsicle too!
en: LUMI: Ooh, I wanna make a caramel popsicle too!
ja: ルミ: わあ　わたしも　キャラメルのアイスキャンディー　作りたい!

key: ACE: All right, Phio goes to dip the end of her staff in the caramel, swirling it about in just the same way to mix as much of it onto the end as she can...
en: ACE: All right, Phio goes to dip the end of her staff in the caramel, swirling it about in just the same way to mix as much of it onto the end as she can...
ja: エース: では　フィオは　つえの先端を　キャラメルに　浸し　できるだけ多く　からめようと　同じように　くるくると　回します……

key: ACE: But suddenly!
en: ACE: But suddenly!
ja: エース: しかし　突然!

key: LUMI: Oh!?
en: LUMI: Oh!?
ja: ルミ: えっ!?

key: ACE: The shadowy figure from within the depths surges over to your side of the shore, and you feel a tremendous force pulling on your staff from within the caramel current!
en: ACE: The shadowy figure from within the depths surges over to your side of the shore, and you feel a tremendous force pulling on your staff from within the caramel current!
ja: エース: 奥にいた影の姿が　あなたのいる岸のほうへと　突進してきて　キャラメルの流れの中から　つえを　ものすごい力で　引っぱられるのを　感じます!

key: LUMI: "Oh! Friends, help-- there's something underneath!"
en: LUMI: "Oh! Friends, help-- there's something underneath!"
ja: ルミ: 「あっ! みんな　助けて――　下に　何か　いる!」

key: ACE: ...Caramel-encrusted sword and all?
en: ACE: ...Caramel-encrusted sword and all?
ja: エース: ……キャラメルまみれの剣も　そのままで　ですか?

key: ZERO: ...Yes.
en: ZERO: ...Yes.
ja: ゼロ: ……ああ。

key: EVE: Does the caramel qualify as a liquid?
en: EVE: Does the caramel qualify as a liquid?
ja: イヴ: このキャラメルは　液体として　扱えるのかしら?

key: ACE: An interesting inquiry!
en: ACE: An interesting inquiry!
ja: エース: 興味深い　問いですね!

key: What are you thinking?
en: What are you thinking?
ja: 何を　考えているんです?

key: EVE: I'm curious if Control Fluid will work on it.
en: EVE: I'm curious if Control Fluid will work on it.
ja: イヴ: 「流体操作」が　効くのか　気になって。

key: ACE: So, you think it will not be quite as effective as it might normally be, but surely there are pockets of molten sugar within the spring that can be manipulated.
en: ACE: So, you think it will not be quite as effective as it might normally be, but surely there are pockets of molten sugar within the spring that can be manipulated.
ja: エース: つまり　通常ほどの効果は　ないだろうが　この温泉の中にも　操作できる　溶けた砂糖のかたまりは　きっと　あるはず　というわけですね。

key: EVE: Let's try it.
en: EVE: Let's try it.
ja: イヴ: やってみるわ。

key: Yveraanya will cast the spell and attempt to hoist the entire figure straight out of the spring.
en: Yveraanya will cast the spell and attempt to hoist the entire figure straight out of the spring.
ja: イヴェラーニャは　呪文を唱え　その影全体を　温泉から　まっすぐ　引き上げようと　試みます。

key: ACE: Please give me a... shall we say, flat intelligence check to manipulate these small bubbles of liquid sugar.
en: ACE: Please give me a... shall we say, flat intelligence check to manipulate these small bubbles of liquid sugar.
ja: エース: では……　そうですね　この小さな液体糖の泡を　操作するための　修正なしの　知力判定を　お願いします。

key: ACE: Impressive!
en: ACE: Impressive!
ja: エース: 見事です!

key: So, yes, you dexterously manage to coax this strange creature of the delicious deep out of its sugary saccharine habitat.
en: So, yes, you dexterously manage to coax this strange creature of the delicious deep out of its sugary saccharine habitat.
ja: それでは　あなたは　巧みに　この奈落に潜む奇妙な生き物を　その甘い生息地から　誘い出すことに　成功します。

key: ACE: As its body breaks above the molten surface, you find yourself face to face with...
en: ACE: As its body breaks above the molten surface, you find yourself face to face with...
ja: エース: その体が　溶けた表面を　突き破ると　あなたは　こう向き合うことに　なります……

key: ACE: A gigantic!
en: ACE: A gigantic!
ja: エース: 巨大な!

key: ACE: Writhing!
en: ACE: Writhing!
ja: エース: のたうつ!

key: ACE: Licorice Eel!
en: ACE: Licorice Eel!
ja: エース: リコリスウナギ!

key: LUMI: Oh!!!
en: LUMI: Oh!!!
ja: ルミ: おお!!!

key: ZERO: Important question, red or black licorice?
en: ZERO: Important question, red or black licorice?
ja: ゼロ: 重要な質問だ　赤リコリスか　黒リコリスか。

key: ACE: Red!
en: ACE: Red!
ja: エース: 赤です!

key: ZERO: Darn.
en: ZERO: Darn.
ja: ゼロ: くそ。

key: EVE: You'd really prefer black...?
en: EVE: You'd really prefer black...?
ja: イヴ: 本当に　黒のほうが　良かったの……?

key: ACE: Casting magic as easily as if it were a fishing rod, Yveraanya dexterously reels the creature to the spring's surface.
en: ACE: Casting magic as easily as if it were a fishing rod, Yveraanya dexterously reels the creature to the spring's surface.
ja: エース: まるで釣りざおを扱うかのように　いともたやすく　魔法を使い　イヴェラーニャは　その生き物を　巧みに　温泉の表面まで　引き寄せます。

key: Its body is an unceasing helix of carmine and caramel, viscous cherry fins forming together at its head in a veritable vortex of teeth and lucre.
en: Its body is an unceasing helix of carmine and caramel, viscous cherry fins forming together at its head in a veritable vortex of teeth and lucre.
ja: その体は　紅とキャラメルが　絶え間なくらせんを描く姿で　頭部には　粘り気のある　サクランボ色のヒレが集まり　まさに歯と黄金の渦を　なしています。

key: Searing spurts of sugar surge out across the spring's shore as its tail wildly thrashes about, finally pulled from the deliquescent depths!
en: Searing spurts of sugar surge out across the spring's shore as its tail wildly thrashes about, finally pulled from the deliquescent depths!
ja: 尾が　激しく暴れるたびに　焼けつくような砂糖のしぶきが　温泉の岸辺に　まき散らされ　ついに　どろどろの深みから　引き上げられました!

key: You see that this creature is, at minimum, the length of several more humans end to end,
en: You see that this creature is, at minimum, the length of several more humans end to end,
ja: この生き物は　少なくとも　人間　数人分を　端から端まで　並べたほどの　長さがあると　わかります

key: And is perhaps prone to preying on the unsuspecting passersby who dare dip their hands in the sugary spring.
en: And is perhaps prone to preying on the unsuspecting passersby who dare dip their hands in the sugary spring.
ja: そして　おそらく　この甘い温泉に　うっかり手を浸してしまった　無警戒な通行人を　えじきに　しているのでしょう。

key: ZERO: I stab the Licorice Eel.
en: ZERO: I stab the Licorice Eel.
ja: ゼロ: リコリスウナギを　刺す。

key: LUMI: But what if it's friendly?!
en: LUMI: But what if it's friendly?!
ja: ルミ: でも　もし　友好的だったら?!

key: ACE: An attack roll, please!
en: ACE: An attack roll, please!
ja: エース: 攻撃ロールを　お願いします!

key: You may have advantage, as Yvera currently has this creature suspended in the air for a brief moment!
en: You may have advantage, as Yvera currently has this creature suspended in the air for a brief moment!
ja: 今　イヴェラが　この生き物を　一瞬　宙に　浮かせているので　有利ロールが　使えますよ!

key: ZERO: ...Natural 20!
en: ZERO: ...Natural 20!
ja: ゼロ: ……クリティカルの20!

key: ACE: In an incredible display of caramel-coated combat from Zoro von Zilchenstein, the cadaverous crusader stabs his sacchariferous saber straight into the eel's aberrant eye!
en: ACE: In an incredible display of caramel-coated combat from Zoro von Zilchenstein, the cadaverous crusader stabs his sacchariferous saber straight into the eel's aberrant eye!
ja: エース: ゾロ・フォン・ジルヒェンシュタインによる　驚くべきキャラメルまみれの戦いぶりで　このしかばねの十字軍戦士は　糖にまみれたサーベルを　ウナギの異形の目へと　まっすぐ　突き刺します!

key: The licorice-like creature tries to blink, but squeals and shivers, every cylinder of its confectionery form howling and convulsing at its honeyed hanger!
en: The licorice-like creature tries to blink, but squeals and shivers, every cylinder of its confectionery form howling and convulsing at its honeyed hanger!
ja: このリコリスのような生き物は　瞬きしようとしますが　悲鳴を上げて震え　その菓子でできた体の　あらゆる部位が　甘い刺し傷に　うめき　のたうちます!

key: With a gnashing and a thrashing, it slams side to side, shattering the glossy glaze of the caramel crest across the sword--
en: With a gnashing and a thrashing, it slams side to side, shattering the glossy glaze of the caramel crest across the sword--
ja: 歯ぎしりし　のたうちながら　左右に　激しく身をよじり　剣に張りついた　つややかなキャラメルの膜を　打ち砕いていきます――

key: And in its wild rampage, inadvertently pierces itself through its other eye from its soft and sugary insides!
en: And in its wild rampage, inadvertently pierces itself through its other eye from its soft and sugary insides!
ja: そして　その暴れっぷりの中で　うっかり　自らの　柔らかく甘い体内から　もう片方の目を　貫いてしまいます!

key: LUMI: "Nice hit, Zoro!!"
en: LUMI: "Nice hit, Zoro!!"
ja: ルミ: 「ナイスヒット　ゾロ!!」

key: ZERO: "Feh... Something like this is nothing."
en: ZERO: "Feh... Something like this is nothing."
ja: ゼロ: 「フン……　この程度　どうということもない」

key: ACE: You withdraw your rapier as the newly-blinded beast falls to the ground, its head bouncing on the surface of the shore in complete confoundment.
en: ACE: You withdraw your rapier as the newly-blinded beast falls to the ground, its head bouncing on the surface of the shore in complete confoundment.
ja: エース: あなたが　レイピアを　引き抜くと　視力を失ったばかりの獣は　地面に　崩れ落ち　その頭は　困惑しきった様子で　岸の表面を　跳ねます。

key: A long and winding licorice tongue lollygags out of its teleost maw, and you see, tied at the end of it...
en: A long and winding licorice tongue lollygags out of its teleost maw, and you see, tied at the end of it...
ja: 長く曲がりくねったリコリスの舌が　硬骨魚のような口から　だらりと垂れ下がり　その先端に　結びつけられているのは……

key: ...Is a birdcage.
en: ...Is a birdcage.
ja: ……鳥かごです。

key: ZERO: ...Did we just skip a whole combat with that crit?
en: ZERO: ...Did we just skip a whole combat with that crit?
ja: ゼロ: ……今の一撃で　戦闘まるごと　スキップしたのか?

key: ACE: I'll never tell~
en: ACE: I'll never tell~
ja: エース: それは　秘密です〜

key: EVE: Yveraanya will open the bird cage.
en: EVE: Yveraanya will open the bird cage.
ja: イヴ: イヴェラーニャは　鳥かごを　開けます。

key: ACE: As you open it, you notice that it seems this cage is enchanted with no small number of sigils.
en: ACE: As you open it, you notice that it seems this cage is enchanted with no small number of sigils.
ja: エース: それを開けると　このかごには　少なからぬ数の　紋章の魔法が　かけられているのに　気づきます。

key: Some, you recognize as being for protection.
en: Some, you recognize as being for protection.
ja: いくつかは　守護のためのものだと　わかります。

key: Others, for containment.
en: Others, for containment.
ja: 他は　封じ込めのためのものです。

key: But you are able to quickly undo the latch, and no sooner than you do, a small shape sharply shoots out of the enclosure, and buzzes around you!
en: But you are able to quickly undo the latch, and no sooner than you do, a small shape sharply shoots out of the enclosure, and buzzes around you!
ja: ですが　留め金は　すばやく　外すことができ　その瞬間　小さな影が　鋭くおりから　飛び出して　あなたの周りを　ブンブンと　飛び回ります!

key: You quickly recognize the figure as some kind of flying fae, eager to stretch its wings and taste freedom for the first time after surely far too long...
en: You quickly recognize the figure as some kind of flying fae, eager to stretch its wings and taste freedom for the first time after surely far too long...
ja: それは　どうやら　飛行する妖精の一種で　あまりに長い時間を経て　初めて　翼を伸ばし　自由の味を　かみしめようとしているのだと　すぐに　わかります……

key: As it does so, you finally get a good look at her...
en: As it does so, you finally get a good look at her...
ja: そうしているうちに　ようやく　彼女の姿を　はっきりと　見ることが　できます……

key: LUMI: What does she look like?
en: LUMI: What does she look like?
ja: ルミ: どんな見た目?

key: ACE: A wonderful question!
en: ACE: A wonderful question!
ja: エース: すばらしい質問ですね!

key: ACE: Little starlet,
en: ACE: Little starlet,
ja: エース: 小さな花形さん

key: Would you please describe your character to us?
en: Would you please describe your character to us?
ja: あなたのキャラクターを　私たちに　説明していただけますか?

key: CIEL: Hello, \PN!
en: CIEL: Hello, \PN!
ja: シエル: ごきげんよう\PN!

key: Hello, everyone~
en: Hello, everyone~
ja: みなさん　こんにちは〜

key: I'm afraid I haven't had the pleasure to get to know you all terribly well in our previous endeavors, but...
en: I'm afraid I haven't had the pleasure to get to know you all terribly well in our previous endeavors, but...
ja: これまでの冒険では　あなたたちのことを　まだ　あまり　よく知る機会が　なかったのだけれど……

key: I hope you will be welcoming and patient with me as I'm learning the game.
en: I hope you will be welcoming and patient with me as I'm learning the game.
ja: ゲームを　覚えていく間　温かく　辛抱強く　見守ってくれると　うれしいわ。

key: Something like this is... certainly a first.
en: Something like this is... certainly a first.
ja: こういうのは……　確かに　初めてね。

key: ACE: I'm sure we'll all be happy to show you the ropes!
en: ACE: I'm sure we'll all be happy to show you the ropes!
ja: エース: みんな　喜んで　コツを　教えてくれますよ!

key: LUMI: Yeah, new players are fun!
en: LUMI: Yeah, new players are fun!
ja: ルミ: うん　新しいプレイヤーって　楽しいよね!

key: ACE: Besides, I'm still trying to convince \PN to join at all.
en: ACE: Besides, I'm still trying to convince \PN to join at all.
ja: エース: それに　私は　まだ\PNを　参加させようと　説得している最中でしてね。

key: In that regard, you're a step ahead of him still!
en: In that regard, you're a step ahead of him still!
ja: その点　あなたは　彼より　一歩　先に　いますよ!

key: In that regard, you're a step ahead of her still!
en: In that regard, you're a step ahead of her still!
ja: その点　あなたは　彼女より　一歩　先に　いますよ!

key: In that regard, you're a step ahead of them still!
en: In that regard, you're a step ahead of them still!
ja: その点　あなたは　あの人より　一歩　先に　いますよ!

key: CIEL: So, Terra plays this with you all as well, does she?
en: CIEL: So, Terra plays this with you all as well, does she?
ja: シエル: それじゃ　テラも　みんなと　これを　プレイしているの?

key: EVE: Whether or not Terra is in this game is...
en: EVE: Whether or not Terra is in this game is...
ja: イヴ: テラが　このゲームに　いるかどうかは……

key: ...An ongoing debate.
en: ...An ongoing debate.
ja: ……いまだに　議論が　続いてるの。

key: CIEL: Say no more, darling.
en: CIEL: Say no more, darling.
ja: シエル: それ以上　言わなくていいわ　あなた。

key: I think I understand the picture perfectly from there.
en: I think I understand the picture perfectly from there.
ja: それだけで　もう　完璧に　わかった気がするもの。

key: Now, as to introductions!
en: Now, as to introductions!
ja: さて　自己紹介の時間ね!

key: Pirellia Pyellia is a pureblood pixie performer from the heart of the confectionary kingdom...
en: Pirellia Pyellia is a pureblood pixie performer from the heart of the confectionary kingdom...
ja: ピレリア・パイエリアは　お菓子の王国の中心から来た　純血の妖精の踊り子で……

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ

key: Clawitzer
en: Clawitzer
ja: ブロスター

key: Mr. Mime
en: Mr. Mime
ja: バリヤード
